title: Game in a day - TinyBots. Godot + Astra.
author: eleuthrios
selftext:
In 2012, myself and a few friends created TinyBots for the first iPhone. Took us about a month to make, using unity and blender. We were not very good at coding at that point, so we hard-coded all 200 levels spawn logic in this horrendous if level == X logic block in a multiple thousand line file that was a nightmare to tweak.

Today, I wanted to see if I could recreate the game from my design notes from an old notebook, and used Astra to recreate the game in Godot. 

Try the demo here: [https://dkdwrek.itch.io/tinybots](https://dkdwrek.itch.io/tinybots)
